	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	If (&TrnContext.TransactionName = &Pgmname and &Mode = TrnMode.Insert)
		For &TrnContextAtt in &TrnContext.Attributes
			Do Case
				// When inserting with instantiated ExtrusionExtrusoraId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"ExtrusionExtrusoraId"
					&Insert_ExtrusionExtrusoraId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
				// When inserting with instantiated ExtrusionTurnoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"ExtrusionTurnoId"
					&Insert_ExtrusionTurnoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
				// When inserting with instantiated ExtrusionProductoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"ExtrusionProductoId"
					&Insert_ExtrusionProductoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
				// When inserting with instantiated ExtrusionOperadorId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"ExtrusionOperadorId"
					&Insert_ExtrusionOperadorId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
				// When inserting with instantiated ExtrusionSiloId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"ExtrusionSiloId"
					&Insert_ExtrusionSiloId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
				// When inserting with instantiated ExtrusionSiloMolidoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"ExtrusionSiloMolidoId"
					&Insert_ExtrusionSiloMolidoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
			Endcase
		Endfor
	Endif
	
    [web]
    {
	ExtrusionId.Visible = False
	ExtrusionExtrusoraId.Visible = False
	DB.ExtrusionTurnoId.Visible = False
	ExtrusionProductoId.Visible = False
	ExtrusionInterrupcionEnCurso.Visible = False
	ExtrusionOperadorNombre.Visible = False
	}
